data.narrative:
Steady Energy is a Series G nuclear energy company that has raised €32M ($32M equivalent) to date. The broader nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers, among them Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy, though narrow-stage peer comparables remain constrained.

Given the data available, only stage-progression methodology is reliably applicable. Using total capital raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.25x step-up multiplier typical for Series G advancement yields an implied valuation of $40M. A peer-median approach cannot be supported; while 6 same-sector peers exist, insufficient datapoints meet the same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters necessary for meaningful triangulation—relying on all-sector medians would introduce misleading dispersion.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $34M to $46M, centered on $40M. This range reflects the single applicable method and incorporates modest sensitivity around stage-typical progression multiples. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to sparse late-stage nuclear private comparables, sector-specific technical and regulatory milestones not captured in raised capital alone, and the lack of sufficient same-stage peers to validate whether 1.25x adequately reflects Steady Energy's specific risk and progress profile versus broader Series G cohorts.
